area: testbed adoption: the spatial-grid broadphase contract

find.report_claim: keystone.broadphase.SpatialGrid documents two guarantees that consumers depend on: 'cell size is a performance trade-off, not a correctness setting', and results come back in insertion order so output stays deterministic
find.live_evidence: shooter imports SpatialGrid in shooter/sim.py:16 and builds it every wave at sim.py:236-238 for the wall colliders, but no shooter test imported the module directly; keystone's own suite asserts a fixed cell size only, so invariance across cell sizes was unproven
find.consumer_evidence: the first draft of the cell-size test queried proxy centres only, and a centre-only registration mutation still passed it; only an edge-cell query at a small cell size exposes the multi-cell registration the module depends on

read: shooter/sim.py grid construction and the existing test_keystone_mechanics grid assertions
killed: re-asserting keystone's own cases (overlap filtering, move/remove) at a single cell size: duplicates the module suite without adding a consumer guarantee
asserting results by centre-only queries: a centre-cell-only registration passes, which is exactly the bug multi-cell registration prevents
expecting a NaN box to reach the grid: AABB rejects it first, so that guard is defensive-only and cannot be a consumer test
analyze.survivor: assert identical query/point/pairs answers across cell sizes 0.05 to 1024, an edge-only query on a large proxy, insertion-order ranking that survives re-insert, the inclusive cell budget with its named limit, linear-scan degradation for an oversized query, and validation of both constructors

fix.shooter: tests/test_keystone_broadphase_mechanics.py (12 tests) covers cell-size invariance of query/query_point/pairs, edge-cell registration for a large proxy, insertion-order results and pairs, rank retention on update, stale-cell removal on re-insert, remove/clear/membership, empty and zero-extent proxies, cell_size validation, the inclusive MAX_PROXY_CELLS budget, oversized-query degradation, non-finite handling at the AABB boundary, and two-grid agreement; README testbed and tree rows added

shooter.mutation: sorting candidates by a constant instead of insertion rank failed the ordering and re-rank tests; registering a proxy only in its centre cell failed 4 tests (cell-size invariance, edge cell, ordering, cell budget); keystone/broadphase.py restored byte-identically (sha256 match)
